meta.title: Microservice Relation Mapping — v1 implementation
meta.description: Implementation plan for the v1 mapping tool per accepted design (ADR-0002): deterministic per-repo extraction to fragments, tiered cross-repo assembly, human-input layer, and CLI/Markdown/MCP surfaces. Source designs: docs/DESIGN.md, docs/design/*.md.

directives.notes: Follow team standards: Python via uv/ruff; files < 800 lines (prefer < 500); every script carries a contract and paired tests per the auditable-script process; glossary changes must pass glossarian-check. Design docs are accepted SoT — implementation deviations require a decision-log entry before code.

tasks.title: Initialize uv Python project skeleton
tasks.description: pyproject with uv/ruff/ty/pytest, src layout, pinned minimal deps, repo layout matching data-model.md artifact set. Include pre-commit running ruff + glossarian-check on docs/glossary.md.

tasks.title: Pin tree-sitter runtime and grammars; smoke-parse fixtures
tasks.description: tree-sitter Python bindings plus grammars for python, java, javascript, typescript, go, hcl, proto. Fixture files per language; smoke test asserts parse without errors and records grammar versions.

tasks.title: CI pipeline: lint, typecheck, tests, doc gates
tasks.description: GitHub Actions (or org standard) running ruff, ty, pytest, glossarian-check; fails on files exceeding 800 lines.

tasks.title: Repo enumeration module (two orgs, team ownership)
tasks.description: Enumerate repos across both GitHub orgs via gh/API with caching; filter archived; read `team` custom property; validate against known team list; report missing/unknown teams as data errors. Reimplements patterns from semgrep_scan_repos.py cleanly (D1).

tasks.title: Mirror sync driver and corpus manifest
tasks.description: Clone/pull all enumerated repos plus platform repos (D5) into local corpus dirs; emit a deterministic manifest of repo -> commit SHA consumed by fragments' meta. Must also accept the existing ~/repositories and ~/verygood-ops mirrors as a pre-synced corpus.

tasks.title: Fragment schema module
tasks.description: Pydantic models + deterministic JSON serialization for the fragment format in data-model.md (provides, consumes_sync, channels, infra, deploy, identity_hints, unparsed). Round-trip and determinism tests (byte-identical on unchanged input).

tasks.title: Service-identity seeder
tasks.description: Produce mapping/services.proposed.yaml from Helm chart names, k8s service names, GitOps app definitions, terraform-aws-vgs-<service> naming, compass.yml, and GH team property, with seeded_by provenance per annotations.md. Never rewrites promoted entries; reports disagreements.

tasks.title: Owner promotion pass over seeded mapping table
tasks.description: Human review: promote proposed entries into mapping/services.yaml, correct drifted names, confirm team attribution. Interactive by design — identity is the trust anchor for the whole graph.

tasks.title: Extraction framework
tasks.description: Per-repo walk with language routing, test-dir detection (context: test attribute), generated-code detection, unparsed-file reporting, fragment writer, parallel per-repo execution. Extractor plugin interface: one module per language/evidence source.

tasks.title: Python extractor
tasks.description: Routes (Flask/FastAPI/Django), HTTP clients (requests/httpx/aiohttp/urllib), boto3 channel ops (SQS/SNS/EventBridge/Kinesis), Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS clients, gRPC stubs. Emit AST-derived module namespace per call site (ADR-0002) and dynamic_url flag. Golden tests on fixture mini-repos.

tasks.title: Java extractor
tasks.description: Spring routes/RestTemplate/WebClient/Feign/OkHttp, AWS SDK v1/v2 channel ops, Kafka clients, gRPC generated stubs. Declared-package namespace per call site; dynamic_url flag; golden tests.

tasks.title: JavaScript/TypeScript extractor
tasks.description: Express/Nest/Koa/Fastify routes, fetch/axios/node:http clients, aws-sdk v2/v3 channel ops, Kafka/NATS clients, gRPC. Module-specifier namespace; dynamic_url flag; golden tests.

tasks.title: Go extractor
tasks.description: net/http and gin/echo/chi/gorilla routes, http clients, aws-sdk-go v1/v2 channel ops, Kafka/NATS clients, gRPC. Package namespace; dynamic_url flag; golden tests.

tasks.title: Terraform extractor
tasks.description: HCL parse of channel resources (aws_sqs_queue, aws_sns_topic, aws_cloudwatch_event_*, aws_kinesis_*, MSK), env-var wiring in task definitions/lambda env blocks, service attribution via terraform-aws-vgs-<service> convention and infrastructure-live paths. Golden tests.

tasks.title: Helm/Envoy deploy extractor
tasks.description: vgs-charts/vgs-gitops values traversal: serviceEnvoy.egress blocks (listen_port -> target host:port), k8s service names, env var blocks, cell namespaces; attribute each values file to its service. Resolve the verygood.gitops vs vgs-gitops question (DESIGN open item 3) and record the answer in the decision log. Golden tests.

tasks.title: Central contract extractors (messages, product)
tasks.description: Proto index over verygoodsecurity/messages (package.Service/Method -> owning service candidates) and HTTP spec index over verygoodsecurity/product. Feeds T2 matching.

tasks.title: Graph schema and stable-ID module
tasks.description: Node/edge models per data-model.md; ID construction incl. path normalization and the amended unres signature (AST namespace + ordinal collision fallback + hard-fail); deterministic graph.json serialization. Property tests for ID stability under file moves.

tasks.title: T1 config-resolvers
tasks.description: Envoy egress join (localhost:port -> egress listen_port -> k8s FQDN -> service), k8s FQDN literals, env-var chain resolution (code -> helm values/task def/terraform), Terraform channel join. First-hit-wins ordering with corroboration/conflict recording per matching.md.

tasks.title: T2 contract corroboration
tasks.description: Proto symbol join via messages index; HTTP spec join via product index; unique-provider requirement; ambiguity emission otherwise.

tasks.title: T3 shape matcher with noise guards
tasks.description: Canonical contract IDs, noisy-shape filter (health/metrics/root/single-param/multi-provider), gap-fill-only semantics, ambiguous_with emission. Never overrides T1/T2.

tasks.title: Human-input merge and validate subcommand
tasks.description: Load mapping/services.yaml, annotations/, overrides/assertions.yaml (T0), overrides/suppressions.yaml; orphan detection; T0-vs-machine conflict reporting; validate subcommand per annotations.md (loud but non-blocking on human-file errors).

tasks.title: Assembly report generator
tasks.description: graph/report.md: coverage, tier mix with trend vs previous committed run, SSRF-ranked unresolved outbound targets (dynamic_url first), ambiguities, conflicts, orphans, channel orphans, unres collision groups. Sorted and diffable.

tasks.title: CLI query tool
tasks.description: Query commands over graph.json: who-calls, calls-of, path A->B, blast-radius, node show (with merged annotation), unresolved list with SSRF ranking. Plain-text and JSON output modes (human and agent consumers).

tasks.title: Per-service Markdown view generator
tasks.description: services/<service-id>.md: endpoints, dependencies, dependents, channels, external targets, unresolved suspects, merged sidecar prose. Browsable on GitHub with zero tooling.

tasks.title: MCP server over the query layer
tasks.description: Thin MCP wrapper exposing the same query engine as the CLI (stdio). No graph mutation via MCP.

tasks.title: Full-corpus run against local mirrors
tasks.description: Run extraction + assembly across the complete corpus (~300 service repos + platform repos). Record runtime/memory; fix crashers and grammar gaps; iterate until the run completes cleanly and deterministically (second run byte-identical).

tasks.title: Owner review of first assembled map
tasks.description: Human review of graph, report, and per-service views: sanity-check known relationships, triage top unresolved/ambiguous findings, seed initial assertions/suppressions/annotations. Produces the tuning worklist for 5.3.

tasks.title: Tune matching from review findings
tasks.description: Adjust noise filters, resolver ordering issues, extractor gaps identified in 5.2; re-run; verify tier-mix and unresolved-count improvements in the report trend.

tasks.title: Map-repo bootstrap and regeneration runbook
tasks.description: Commit artifacts to the map repo with README, regeneration runbook (workstation + future CI), and generated_by headers verified. Documents the fragment handoff contract for future per-repo CI (D1).

tasks.title: SSRF triage workflow using the unresolved inventory
tasks.description: Short committed doc: how to use the SSRF-ranked unresolved-target report and unres-node annotations for the GuardDuty investigation; walk the current alert's candidate repos through it as the worked example.
